name: ZeroB AS8 - 8000LPH Water Softener
summary: The ZeroB AutoSoft 8 is a high-capacity automatic water softener designed to remove hardness from water using advanced Purple Resin Media . It provides a continuous supply of soft water, protects plumbing and appliances from scaling, improves soap efficiency, and enhances bathing and washing quality.
features: 8,000 LPH high-flow capacity for large-scale applications.
Advanced Purple Resin Media for efficient hardness removal.
Fully Automatic Programmable Valve for hassle-free operation.
Prevents scale formation in pipelines, geysers, boilers, and appliances.
Eliminates soap scum and improves soap and detergent performance.
Durable FRP composite pressure vessel with HDPE brine tank.
High-capacity 200 L resin bed for long service life.
Efficient automatic regeneration with optimized salt consumption.
Equipped with a centrifugal monoblock regeneration pump.
Compact 6 × 6 ft installation footprint for easy installation.
Suitable for residential complexes, hotels, hospitals, commercial, and industrial water softening.
Durable FRP composite pressure vessel with HDPE brine tank .

rows: Output per Regeneration (at 200 ppm CaCO₃ feed water hardness)
